Freedom Within
A Community Poetry Project by Tuesdays with the Bard @ Urban Solace

Dear Friends,
As our 45-day journey of sharing Freedom Within comes to a close, we simply want to say:

Thank you!
Thank you to every poet who trusted us with their words and chose to be part of this collection.
Thank you to everyone who read a poem, paused for a moment, felt something, remembered something, smiled, reflected, or found a little piece of themselves in these words.
And thank you to everyone who walked alongside us through these 45 days.

What began as an invitation to explore one simple question - What does Freedom Within mean to me? became a beautiful coming together of voices, thoughts, emotions and experiences.
We are deeply grateful to every person we touched through this journey, and to every person who allowed these poems to touch them in return.

Thank you for being part of our journey of Freedom Within.

With Love and Light,
Perry and the Tuesdays with the Bard @ Urban Solace Team

Urban Solace — Your Café for the Soul

One more invitation...
If you would like to receive the complete Freedom Within collection of 45 poems, simply send us a WhatsApp message saying:
“Freedom Within Collection”
to 98450 13055
and we will be happy to send it to you.

And if these 45 days have reminded you of how much poetry can move, connect and inspire us, we would love to welcome you to Tuesdays with the Bard @ Urban Solace, our poetry gathering that happens every Tuesday evening.

Come listen. Come read. Come discover new voices.
Come be part of a community that continues to celebrate local poets and poetry.

We would love to have you with us.
